title: Choose the console's visual world
question: Re-roll 2 (bolder register). The leader is Peta Orientasi. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Peta Orientasi
options.lineage: the orienteering map — iso-standard terrain colours, contours as truth, the course rides in purple over everything
options.thesis: Network health as terrain: outlets as control points, availability as contour colour, the admin's route drawn purple over it.
options.viewport: A paper ground ruled with contours, four control circles carrying outlet status, a legend and four live counts.
options.risk: A map tempts navigation the admin does not need; if the course does not earn its place it is decoration.

raised.raise: Registration crosshairs at plate corners, so every figure carries proof it was placed, not floated.
A vermilion key rail down the centre, so the two halves of the network read as one twin column.
A visible construction grid behind the figures, so the layout is the armature rather than a skin.

options.label: Lembar Plate
options.lineage: the design annual's plate section — uncoated near-white stock, registration crosshairs, a letterpressed circular stamp, hairline credits
options.thesis: Network health as a plate section: every figure a plate with registration marks, one grotesque carrying display and caption.
options.viewport: A 4-up grid of plates with registration marks, a stamp and a mono token bar.
options.case: Fuses well: registration furniture turns a dashboard into a printed sheet, and the single grotesque keeps it calm — but the plate is a poster, and a poster is slow to scan.
options.risk: Beautiful and precise, but a plate section rewards looking, not answering.

options.label: Rel Pusat
options.lineage: the reference-setting page — two short-measure columns twinned around a fixed centre rail of vermilion keys, wide annotation margin
options.thesis: Network health as a reference page: two columns twinned around a vermilion key rail, annotations in the margin.
options.viewport: Two columns of small text around a centre rail of vermilion keys, annotations hung in the margin.
options.case: Fuses with discipline: a reference page is already how an admin reads, and the key rail is a real signature — but the measure fights density on a screen that must answer at a glance.
options.risk: Scholarly and precise, but the columns slow the scan that a health screen owes.

options.label: Kisi Crouwel
options.lineage: the Wim Crouwel gridded specimen — letterforms built cell by cell on a visible construction grid
options.thesis: Network health as a grid: figures monumental in their cells, the construction grid the layout.
options.viewport: A faint blue construction grid across the screen, four invariants as monumental figures in its cells.
options.case: Fuses with discipline: an admin console is a grid already, and making the grid the visible armature is a real system — but monumental type fights density on a phone.
options.risk: Striking and systematic, but the grid can starve the data it frames.

options.label: Dompet Tiket
options.lineage: the jet-age ticket wallet — carbon-copy coupons, route maps, baggage tags choreographing one journey
options.thesis: The network as a coupon book: each outlet a leg, validated, used, or voided, the wallet showing what remains.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the coupon book is a journey, and an admin reading health does not want to tear off legs to find a number.
options.kept: Validated, used, void states stamped onto the record; nothing disappears, it cancels.

options.label: Spesimen Font
options.lineage: the interactive type specimen — dragging an axis slider morphs a whole grid of glyphs in real time
options.thesis: The console as a live type specimen: axes drive the figures, a grid of glyphs breathes in step.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a specimen is about type, and type is not what an admin is reading.
options.kept: Axis-driven variation as a live control, updating every figure without per-element script.

canonCard.label: Standar kategori
canonCard.thesis: Konsol admin yang umum dikirim kategori ini: tanah putih, rail kiri, aksen biru, tabel sortable.
canonCard.viewport: Rail kiri, strip KPI, tabel outlet sortable di atas tanah putih.
canonCard.risk: Tidak bisa dibedakan dari kompetitor secara desain.
